sentences.en: Insecticides are agricultural chemicals that exterminate insects harmful to plants.
sentences.zh: 杀虫剂是消灭危害植物昆虫的农业化学品。

sentences.en: Pesticides are agricultural chemicals that exterminate insects that harm plants.
sentences.zh: 农药是消灭危害作物昆虫的农业化学品。

sentences.en: On the border, there is a stretch of agricultural land.
sentences.zh: 在边境地区有一片农田。

senses.zh: 农业的，与农业有关的；务农的，农用的；<英，非正式>笨拙的
